LESSON: PHYSICAL FEATURES IN THE COUNTY

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade four
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
Strand: Natural and Built Environments
Topic 1.3: Physical Features in the County
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 5

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Physical Features in the County, part of Natural and Built Environments in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade four SOCIAL STUDIES.

Key inquiry question: Why are physical features important for a County? 2. How can you identify the physical features in the county?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Physical Features in the County together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Digital Literacy: learners develop creating with technology as they create some images using digital resources as they sketch

the main physical features in the county

● Creativity and imagination: learners explore while undertaking tasks as they discuss in groups the importance of the main physical

features in the county and share the discussion points in class

Values:
● Social Justice: learners foster fairness as they accord each other equal opportunities in sharing responsibilities, discuss in groups

the importance of the main physical features in the county, and share the discussion points in class

● Love: learners portray a caring attitude as they use digital resources to draw or take photographs of the main physical features

in the county,

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

● Self-Awareness: learners appreciate others' uniqueness as they model some of the main physical features in the county,

● Citizenship: learners engage effectively with others as they display pictures or models of the main physical features in the

county in class,

Links to other Learning Areas:
● English and Kenya Sign Language: learners apply discussion skills learned in English as they discuss in groups the

importance of the main physical features in the county and share the discussion points in class,
